snippets.author: Katherine Wells
snippets.text: 1st time going to the theaters here.  Very nice.  Big comfy chairs with built in cupholders. Think there 10 viewing screens.  Great buttered popcorn. Nice sound.  Huge clean bathrooms.  BIG SCREENS!

snippets.author: Carol Henderson
snippets.text: My husband and I were a bit confused last night when we first came in. But the guy at the concessions counter was extremely nice and he took the time to talk to us go over all the details, and we ended up having a very nice conversation. Would definitely come back

snippets.author: CARRIE KROSCHEL
snippets.text:
Updated Review....
I am making my review 1 atar after another very disappointing experience.  This theaterneeds serious work... the screen is so dark i couldn't concentrate on the movie.. I will not come back until I hear they have made changes!

Love the senior deal on Wednesdays but today the theater was ice cold, the screen was way too dark, and the butter on the popcorn tasted rancid. Not a great experience but maybe you get what you pay for here.

snippets.author: Wil Slacks
snippets.text: Went saw a movie a very nice theater price is reasonable and they have a senior combo which was amazing. Definitely will go back.

snippets.author: DeenLee A
snippets.text: We enjoy our movies with some Buffalo Wild Wings every time we go. It's nice to bring a beer in.

snippets.author: Cara Tompsett
snippets.text:
Havasu Elks RV
Elmer and Jewls the camp host couple are absolutely delightful, very helpful and definitely great hosts. We could not say enough about how well they do their job. Our camp site #14 was FAR more spacious than we had hope for.  With full hookups and a distant view of the lake, we were thrilled with our spot. the lodge is hopping!...like every night with some great meal or fun event. a few things to note. the RV area is sharp crushed road based gravel. it works fine but pretty hard on your pups paws. there is NO grass anywhere..pretty much in Havasu at all. These folks love their rock and cement. The Havasu Elks bar is cash only (atm in bar) but meals and events credit/debit or cash is accepted. Wonderful lodge and every meal, event and interaction was great. Of note, Havasu is an official Dark Sky area..so, we brought a telescope and were not disappointed. From our campsite clear dark sky made for excellent stargazing and we enjoyed sharing the views with whoever wanted to participate while we were there. also, Franconia is close by and the largest and most productive Meteorite field on earth. Careful planning can score a fun day of hunting and perhaps some treasures. Lastly, while $200 plus per person was not in our plans to go out boating we did score the $5 round trip ferry to the casino and back and had a very nice lakeside lunch while there. That was an unexpected sweet find. Peace✌️ my Fellow Elks.

snippets.author: Courter Country Farm
snippets.text:
“Greeted” horribly by the RV camp host. Arriving in a class C with a car dolly. Attempting to find our space and make sure we don’t get stuck when the “host” began yelling at me to check-in. I had been there less than 2 minutes. Offered him and lodge a chance to make this right before reviewing but apparently they think this is how to treat out of towners.
As a host of our own even venue, I would be helping my guests with parking and way finding. I wouldn’t dream of watching them struggle and screaming at them to check in. I would also not stay on business long.
I wrote to the lodge and NO RESPONSE. They even charged my card when we asked for a refund.
Besides the HORRIBLE camp host, this is merely a gravel parking lot, quite a ways from the lake and all things fun. Do yourself a favor and skip this lodge.

snippets.author: Vicki Morrison
snippets.text: Very active lodge,  it has a large membership with friendly members. Food is quality and drinks are cold.  Plenty of parking and an RV park available for members for an affordable price ( reservation recommended).

snippets.author: Anthony McCool
snippets.text:
It says members only but I got in. They take prospective members. PBR on tap is $2.50, sweetest!!!  Nice set up. I think I will be joining when I get back to Yuma.
See our YouTube channel Coolest Life.

snippets.author: Lemmie Klein
snippets.text: Nice wide RV spots. FULL Hook-ups and really nice camp hosts.  Say hello to Mike and Tracy when you call to reserve a spot.  Great meals at the lodge.

snippets.author: Virginia Hertz
snippets.text:
We really used to love this place. Coming from Kingman weekly to have my special-needs son do therapy at mile markers. It was very convenient to have the jump place right next-door so my other kids had something to do while waiting.

I have a 15, 12, 7, 5 and at the time one year-old. We had been coming for over a year and had memberships for all of the kids except my one year-old Seeing as how she couldn’t walk.

My Older kids would play and I would sit with my one year-old and let her crawl around.

As soon as my 1 year old stood up and used the wall to walk around the perimeter of the play area staff( not a kid) came and told me I needed to buy her a membership since she was using the facilities.

I thought this was absolutely ridiculous considering she couldn’t even climb up on anything or jump.
And for me, it was not like I’m trying to be a cheap scape. I spent hundreds of dollars there a month and I’m fine with supporting a business. And I was actually excited for these business owners because my dad used to be a fisherman and knew them personally. But it’s pretty petty to make A frequent customer that spends a ton of money pay for a one year-old’s jump membership when she can’t even jump.

Every time we were there, I spent close to 50 or $60 buying pizza and drink drinks And the Massage chairs.

Definitely lost a loyal customer

snippets.author: Carlos Morales
snippets.text: Staff were really friendly and one staff member blonde girl seen a kid getting out of control and she immediately called him out. Great job on keeping everything safe. The older kids were really considerate of the younger kids. My kids are 4 and 5. I thought that was really sweet. Clean place and staff was really friendly. Will go again and get membership.

snippets.author: Krystine Watson
snippets.text: This is an excellent trampoline park. Has a lot of activities and variety. It's well supervised and clean. My only criticism that the 6 and under play area is not truly built for little kids. Children under 3 will have trouble climbing the slide structure and it's not very accessible to adults to get in for assistance.

snippets.author: Meghan
snippets.text: My daughter loves this place.  The price to jump is very reasonable and there are many different trampoline involved activities to do.  Music is played and they have food and drinks available for purchase as well as rooms for birthday parties.  I plan to get my daughter a monthly pass to jump daily when she is with me during the summer.

snippets.author: chenique Smith
snippets.text: I had the. Best day with my grandson ! Kelvin was the. Best !

name: Lake Havasu Museum of History & Havasu Rocks

snippets.author: Katie Moore
snippets.text: Informative small museum worth a visit. A small portion of the museum is dedicated to the native population living in the  area before Parker Dam was built. Of course lots of info on McCulloch. Scary jail outside the museum. Not very old really - 1970’s. Some fun activities for kids.

snippets.author: Joseph Garrett
snippets.text: Good community museum covering the area history especially the London bridge.  Friendly staff.  Donation appreciated.  We spent about an hour viewing.  Really interesting history.  I recommend if you love history.

snippets.author: Angelique Hoefl
snippets.text:
A great little museum with lots of information about Lake Havasu City, the London Bridge, Parker Dam, steamboats, local wildlife and with great rocks, activities for kids and a little store. It's free to visit and you can make a donation to help that the museum can stays open.
My 2-year-old twins especially enjoyed the children's corner with books, magnetic sand and coloring. They also loved the 3 animals, a gecko, a lizard and a spider.

snippets.author: Jasmine Johnson
snippets.text:
We enjoyed going through this museum.   It had great information about Mr McColluch and Mr Wood, who had the vision to purchase the land and create a city in the desert.   They had displays on the Indians who lived in the area  and their influences.  The London bridge from England is also located in this city and a great tourist attraction.
They also had a special exhibit on the jplane and other lapidary stones on display.  We really enjoyed touring this museum. 👍

snippets.author: Michele Stroud
snippets.text: This is a fascinating little museum with a lot of information. It explains how Lake Havasu City became a city, how London Bridge was acquired and moved, local wild life, and more! It’s by donation only, and well worth a visit!

snippets.author: Andrew Lagravinese
snippets.text: Here for the winter. Active post with something happening all the time. Open 7 days a week with a bar that serves $3 beer on tap as well as $9 pitchers. Food available on certain days as well as live entertainment. Mostly friendly people, welcoming newcomers. Cash only. We’ve spent a lot of cash here!😄

snippets.author: Gayle Patrick (Stormy)
snippets.text:
Currently ALR Secretary, ride with a great bunch of guys, but looking for some other females to ride!
Our staff is friendly!
Friday is tacos early for lunch and then fish fry late.

snippets.author: Tami Strunk
snippets.text: Friendly people, great bartender. Nice patio area and WI bowling tonight. A fun place to hang out

snippets.author: Christopher Bay
snippets.text: Friendly people, lots of TVs, patio, and cheap drinks of course.

snippets.author: Ron Phillips
snippets.text: Nice friendly people. The usual smoke but that's the norm. Service was good and the decor up to date and clean for the most part. Liked it. Update, they voted the smoking out, so the main building is non-smoking.  You can smoke outside on the patio which they have made very nice.  Also to facilitate the nonsmoking, they repainted all the walls inside to lose the smoky smell!

snippets.author: Lance
snippets.text:
I had some time to kill in the day so I decided to check out this shop. I had a very nice experience! I didn't feel ignored (would have been hard to do as most of the time I was the only customer in the shop) but I also didn't feel pressured or rushed in any way. The conversation was friendly and they interacted with everyone who came in on a personal level.
I'd highly recommend if you're looking for good quality singles at fair prices that you check out this shop.
I purchased some singles and felt that everything was very fairly priced and that the conditions that they listed were as described or even better. "We have high standards" is what they told me when I remarked on how good the cards looked! I definitely appreciate that.

snippets.author: Phil Shaffer
snippets.text: Do not bring singles here. Absolute scam only offers 31% of card value. They also take over a week for appraisal. Do yourself the favor and just sell to Card Kingdom.

snippets.author: Joseph Guerrero
snippets.text: Very nice vintage Tee Shirts and clothing. Went with my grandson Bryce and purchased a nice shirt at a very reasonable price. I would suggest to give veterans discounts. Otherwise a very well run business.

snippets.author: katreena thompson
snippets.text: Awesome little shop. So friendly and knowledgeable. They offer a card sorting service which I can't wait to use and a good place to kill some time too with the wide variety of board and card games they have to play.

snippets.author: R Davis
snippets.text: Some of the best customer service I have ever gotten in a hobby store. Had no clue what to get for my husband for his birthday. Went in here and Sam was amazing! She asked me all the right questions to find out what my husband was into and helped me find the perfect gift. I am in Havasu rarely so she was able to order what I wanted and ship it to me! I won't go to any other store. Sam knows her stuff and is pretty awesome! She is nice and helpful.

snippets.author: Steve Lomax
snippets.text: James was helpful over the phone to help me with attempting to resolve my issues. Determined that the problem was more involved James came to my home and was there when he said he would be there. James was very knowledgeable and very helpful in getting my pinball ball game up and working great. He was very responsive and very fair with his prices. I would highly recommend him if you need any assistance or repairs.

snippets.author: Janice Johnson
snippets.text: I just had James come to my home to fix my Double Diamond machine that had a dead battery, which requires soldering, and clearing the ram. He called when he was on his way and arrived on time. This machine was new to me, so he made sure everything was working properly. If I need any repairs in the future I know who I am calling!

snippets.author: Kurt
snippets.text: Called James and he was able to come to the house in less than an hour. Video poker multi-game machine had a problem with being disabled after being in storage for 5 months. James fixed it and now we are up and playing again. James was GREAT and I would highly recommend.

snippets.author: drholthaus Holthaus
snippets.text: Very knowledgeable &  personal. Has a great attitude & sets his mind to find a solution to your problem. Dependable on keeping his appointments and following thru. I highly recommend  this professional individual to work on my equipment. Thank you James!

snippets.author: Leighton Kidder
snippets.text: Very knowledgeable, on time, very easy to work with and willing to share his knowledge on your machine.  I would not have bought a pinball machine if he wasn’t here to help. And willing to help you over the phone.

snippets.author: Victor B
snippets.text:
This a diamond in the rough in that it’s a bit hidden in the restaurant level of The Barley Brewery and  Shugrue’s fine dining. Very nice upscale selection of clothes and jewelry and some other accessories. Nice staff. It’s small but cool!
VictorB

snippets.author: Casandra LA
snippets.text: Beautiful boutique and art gallery. Unique one of a kind jewelry and art. Affordable fun jewelry and accessories. Stylish clothing, very nicely priced. Very friendly. Helpful. Tatyana made my day.🙂

snippets.author: Shelly Robert
snippets.text: The owner was very very helpful with picking out an outfit for me!! As soon as I walked in I was greeted with a warm welcome! Everything in this store is absolutely breathtaking! Never get rid of this store

snippets.author: Lori Wells Beier
snippets.text: This place is fantastic!  Full of sparkly clothes, shoes and jewelry plus beautiful artwork.  The owner is always super helpful too. I highly recommend this store and their sister store Barracuda.

snippets.author: R M
snippets.text: The owner or the lady with accent, is a very rude person. She needs to learn how to accept criticism. Not everything in your store is as beautiful as you think!

snippets.author: Tom Tezel

snippets.text: Best VW Bus show EVER!!! Big thank you to London Bridge Bullis for hosting an awesome show every year!! And props for the donations they make to the community with the profits.

very cool

snippets.text: Amazing People! Super helpful people! Anne is an amazing person that helped me out big time when i was in a bind!! She is amazing and so is the whole crew! Thank you, you heled me make my daughters quince very special!
